question: Should OpenClaw reserve the top-level `auth` CLI root for core model-auth shortcuts despite the documented plugin root-command extension contract?
rationale: The alias is a product-facing namespace expansion, and preserving or displacing existing plugin commands requires an ownership and compatibility policy that automation cannot invent.

options.title: Keep the plugin namespace
options.body: Retain `openclaw models auth list` as canonical and avoid adding the top-level root command.

options.title: Reserve auth for core
options.body: Approve `auth` as core-owned, then define and prove collision and upgrade behavior for installed plugins before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep the plugin namespace
recommendation.body: Retain `openclaw models auth list` as canonical and avoid adding the top-level root command.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and PR timeline place this person closest to the plugin ownership side of the decision, although shared CLI ownership remains likely.
